title: canary-rollout-scratchpad-noah-kim
content:
Canary rollout scratchpad - v2.1.3 pinning and checklist

Goal:
- Roll v2.1.3 (FP16 + quant profile q4_0) to hosted fleet with staged canary, validate latency/quality, then ramp to 100%.
- Keep dedicated and private customers pinned until signoff (manual).

Quick notes / constraints:
- v2.1.3 changes: kernel selection tweak for faster KV cache warmup, small tokenizer patch (edge-case whitespace), lower mem overhead for long prompts.
- Expected perf: +8-12% tp50 token latency on T4-equivalent; cost neutral due to batching improvements.
- Risk: tokenizer change could affect structured output tests (evals).

Gating signals (must be green to advance):
1) Latency SLA: p95 <= current_p95 * 1.15 and p50 regression <= 10%
2) Error rate: total 5xx + model errors <= baseline + 0.1% absolute
3) Quality: unit eval prompts (prompt_set/canary_v2) match baseline Rouge/EM thresholds (no >2% drop)
4) Observability: traces and logs show no new N+1 patterns, KV hit-rate stable or improved
5) Cost: cost per token not > 7% increase for canary traffic

Canary plan (staged):
- Step 0 - Pre-check (manual)
  - Ensure infra capacity: check pool headroom (dedicated pools unaffected).
  - Push infra PR applied and smoke-tested on staging.
  - Notify on-call and release slack channel.

- Step 1 - 1% global traffic (10 minutes)
  - Route 1% to v2.1.3 via router policy: route policy id: canary-noah-2026-02
  - Monitor: latency dashboards, error rate, QA evals (automated), sample responses for structured output (5-10 min sample)
  - Wait 10 minutes, run quick metrics diff, if all green -> proceed

- Step 2 - 5% (20 minutes)
  - Increase to 5%, enable extended eval set (100 prompts) against production sampling pool
  - Run content regression checks (structured output) and manual review of flagged samples
  - If any structural regressions -> rollback immediately

- Step 3 - 25% (30-60 minutes)
  - Ramp to 25% with canary window 60m, run full regression suite (trigger nightly evals if possible)
  - Run spike test: short burst of 2x baseline QPS to watch autoscaling behaviors

- Step 4 - 100% (gradual over 2 hours)
  - Only after signoff from QA and SRE, start gradual ramp to 100% with abort windows

Rollback plan:
- Immediate rollback triggers:
  - p95 > threshold or error spike > threshold
  - any critical structured output regression discovered by QA
- Rollback command (infra):
  - router rollback: rw-router rollback --policy canary-noah-2026-02 --to-version v2.1.2
  - revert infra PR if needed and re-deploy
- Post-rollback: capture detailed logs, create JIRA-REL ticket, schedule bugfix sprint if regression confirmed

Version pinning notes:
- Dedicated/private customers: do NOT auto-upgrade. Manual opt-in only. Email templates prepped in slack thread and CS playbook.
- CLI pin example: rwctl set-version --deployment customer-abc --model modelX --version v2.1.2
- Ensure model catalog entry updated with compatibility notes (tokenizer change) and migration notes in Confluence page.

Monitoring checklist (dashboard + alerts):
- Latency dashboard: canary vs baseline (p50/p95/p99)
- Error rate: 5xx, model-runtime-exceptions, tokenization errors
- Cost telemetry: tokens/sec, cost per token estimate
- Evals: automated regression job link in artifacts; compare metrics to baseline and flag deviations >1.5%
- Sample corpus: random 200 responses saved to S3 prefix canary-samples/noah-2026-02-20 for manual review

Communication & coordination:
- Pre-rollout: ping #releases, #sre, #infra 30m before start (include rollout plan, rollback steps, time window)
- During roll: concise status updates every step completion in thread
- Post-roll: short postmortem template (if rollback) or rollout summary (if success) in Confluence and release notes

TODOs (action items):
- [ ] Finalize canary policy in router (infra owner: Samir) -> target segments and session affinity
- [ ] Add tokenizer regression tests to eval harness (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Update model catalog entry w/ migration notes (owner: Noah)
- [ ] Draft CS email for dedicated customers (owner: Alex)
- [ ] Run dry-run on staging with synthetic load (owner: Samir/Pipeline)

Notes to self:
- Keep an eye on metrics around KV cache warmup (first-token latency spikes in traces)
- If structured output fails, check tokenizer patch first (likely culprit)
- Remember to mark release as "pinned-dedicated" in catalog metadata to avoid accidental auto-roll

Scratch/commands (for reference):
- deploy: rwctl deploy --model modelX --version v2.1.3 --route-policy canary-noah-2026-02 --initial-weight 0.01
- increase weight: rwctl route set-weight --policy canary-noah-2026-02 --weight 0.05
- rollback: rwctl route set-weight --policy canary-noah-2026-02 --weight 0.0 && rwctl remove-version --model modelX --version v2.1.3

End of scratchpad. Will convert into a formal playbook after first successful canary.
